text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the static 3px ring at 7:1 contrast with a 1px solid border. This meets WCAG AAA for focus visibility while keeping the ring crisp on all screens and touch targets. The trade-off is slightly larger visual weight, but it eliminates ambiguity for keyboard users and reduces fatigue during long sessions.

name: Reader
text: The static 3px ring at 7:1 still fails users who need *both* high contrast *and* reduced motion—7:1 is too heavy for motion-sensitive users, and the 3px width adds visual noise. A better alternative: use a 1px ring at 4.5:1 with a 2px solid border, switching to 2px at 7:1 only when reduced motion is off. Settle it by testing with users who have both contrast and motion needs.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 1px ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 2px solid border, switching to 2px at 7:1 only when reduced motion is enabled. This balances high visibility for keyboard users with comfort for motion-sensitive users, meeting WCAG AA for contrast while avoiding visual noise. The trade-off is slightly less immediate visibility in default mode, but it prevents exclusion for a significant user group.

name: Reader
text: The 1px ring at 4.5:1 risks failing users who need *both* high contrast *and* keyboard navigation—4.5:1 is below AAA for focus visibility, leaving some users guessing where they are. A better alternative: use a 2px ring at 7:1 by default, switching to 1px at 4.5:1 only when motion is enabled. Settle it with user testing: measure task completion time and error rates for keyboard users with and without motion sensitivity.
